predicates.label: Null
predicates.definition: Stored value is NULL / is not NULL.

predicates.label: Non-null
predicates.definition: Stored value is NULL / is not NULL.

predicates.label: Semantically missing
predicates.definition: Value matches the declared missingness rule / supplies a value under that rule. Rule may include nulls, blanks and sentinels.

predicates.label: Semantically present
predicates.definition: Value matches the declared missingness rule / supplies a value under that rule. Rule may include nulls, blanks and sentinels.

predicates.label: Whitespace-only
predicates.definition: A non-null string consists entirely of the selected whitespace characters / contains at least one other character.

predicates.label: Contains non-whitespace
predicates.definition: A non-null string consists entirely of the selected whitespace characters / contains at least one other character.

predicates.label: Default-valued
predicates.definition: Value equals the selected default value / differs; does not infer whether a default mechanism produced it.

predicates.label: Non-default-valued
predicates.definition: Value equals the selected default value / differs; does not infer whether a default mechanism produced it.

predicates.label: Sentinel-valued
predicates.definition: Value belongs / does not belong to a declared placeholder set, e.g. unknown-code markers.

predicates.label: Non-sentinel-valued
predicates.definition: Value belongs / does not belong to a declared placeholder set, e.g. unknown-code markers.

predicates.label: Empty payload
predicates.definition: A non-null LOB/document collection has zero content length or zero members / more than zero, under the chosen representation.

predicates.label: Non-empty payload
predicates.definition: A non-null LOB/document collection has zero content length or zero members / more than zero, under the chosen representation.

predicates.label: Complete record
predicates.definition: All required fields are semantically present / at least one required field is missing.

predicates.label: Incomplete record
predicates.definition: All required fields are semantically present / at least one required field is missing.

predicates.label: All populated
predicates.definition: In a nonempty selected column/group: every value is present; some but not all are present; none are present.

predicates.label: Partly populated
predicates.definition: In a nonempty selected column/group: every value is present; some but not all are present; none are present.

predicates.label: All missing
predicates.definition: In a nonempty selected column/group: every value is present; some but not all are present; none are present.

predicates.label: Required value supplied
predicates.definition: Among rows where a declared condition requires a field, that field is present / missing.

predicates.label: Required value missing
predicates.definition: Among rows where a declared condition requires a field, that field is present / missing.

predicates.label: Sufficient completeness
predicates.definition: Present-value fraction meets / fails a declared minimum, for a nonempty column or group.

predicates.label: Insufficient completeness
predicates.definition: Present-value fraction meets / fails a declared minimum, for a nonempty column or group.

predicates.label: Required combination satisfied
predicates.definition: A specified field-presence rule, such as at least one contact field or both coordinate fields, holds / fails.

predicates.label: Required combination violated
predicates.definition: A specified field-presence rule, such as at least one contact field or both coordinate fields, holds / fails.

predicates.label: Uniqueness
predicates.definition: A row's selected value occurs exactly once / more than once in the chosen population; includes null groups as in the supplied example.

predicates.label: Non-uniqueness
predicates.definition: A row's selected value occurs exactly once / more than once in the chosen population; includes null groups as in the supplied example.

predicates.label: Composite uniqueness
predicates.definition: The selected tuple occurs exactly once / more than once. Includes null components using a consistent grouping convention.

predicates.label: Composite non-uniqueness
predicates.definition: The selected tuple occurs exactly once / more than once. Includes null components using a consistent grouping convention.

predicates.label: Record uniqueness
predicates.definition: The complete declared record projection occurs once / more than once. “Record” means the selected comparison fields, not an assumed business entity.

predicates.label: Record duplication
predicates.definition: The complete declared record projection occurs once / more than once. “Record” means the selected comparison fields, not an assumed business entity.

predicates.label: Unique column or key
predicates.definition: Across a selected nonempty population, no selected value/tuple repeats / at least one repeats. Null policy must be the same on both sides.

predicates.label: Non-unique column or key
predicates.definition: Across a selected nonempty population, no selected value/tuple repeats / at least one repeats. Null policy must be the same on both sides.

predicates.label: Constant
predicates.definition: A nonempty eligible population has exactly one distinct value / more than one. An all-null population is handled by C02 if nulls are excluded.

predicates.label: Varying
predicates.definition: A nonempty eligible population has exactly one distinct value / more than one. An all-null population is handled by C02 if nulls are excluded.

predicates.label: Cardinality within bounds
predicates.definition: Distinct-value count is / is not inside a declared interval; can include zero.

predicates.label: Cardinality outside bounds
predicates.definition: Distinct-value count is / is not inside a declared interval; can include zero.

predicates.label: Key candidate
predicates.definition: Selected key fields are jointly unique and non-null / one or both requirements fail in the observed population. This does not prove future uniqueness.

predicates.label: Not a key candidate
predicates.definition: Selected key fields are jointly unique and non-null / one or both requirements fail in the observed population. This does not prove future uniqueness.

predicates.label: Equals selected value
predicates.definition: Value equals / differs from a specified non-null value. Instantiating this for code 1 produces the original TABLE1.COL1 = 1 partition.

predicates.label: Differs from selected value
predicates.definition: Value equals / differs from a specified non-null value. Instantiating this for code 1 produces the original TABLE1.COL1 = 1 partition.

predicates.label: In selected set
predicates.definition: Value belongs / does not belong to an explicitly selected set.

predicates.label: Outside selected set
predicates.definition: Value belongs / does not belong to an explicitly selected set.

predicates.label: Allowed value
predicates.definition: Value belongs / does not belong to the business-approved domain. Same membership operation as M02, with a normative role.

predicates.label: Disallowed value
predicates.definition: Value belongs / does not belong to the business-approved domain. Same membership operation as M02, with a normative role.

predicates.label: True encoding
predicates.definition: Non-null flag value belongs to the declared true set, false set, or neither; sets must be disjoint.

predicates.label: False encoding
predicates.definition: Non-null flag value belongs to the declared true set, false set, or neither; sets must be disjoint.

predicates.label: Unrecognized encoding
predicates.definition: Non-null flag value belongs to the declared true set, false set, or neither; sets must be disjoint.

predicates.label: Parseable
predicates.definition: Representation can / cannot be interpreted using the selected grammar and locale.

predicates.label: Unparseable
predicates.definition: Representation can / cannot be interpreted using the selected grammar and locale.

predicates.label: Convertible
predicates.definition: Value can / cannot be converted to the specified target datatype under the selected conversion rules.

predicates.label: Non-convertible
predicates.definition: Value can / cannot be converted to the specified target datatype under the selected conversion rules.

predicates.label: Lossless conversion
predicates.definition: Among successfully converted values, specified value or representation information is / is not preserved by the defined comparison.

predicates.label: Lossy conversion
predicates.definition: Among successfully converted values, specified value or representation information is / is not preserved by the defined comparison.

predicates.label: Well formed
predicates.definition: Value satisfies / violates its declared semantic representation contract, e.g. a ten-digit identifier.

predicates.label: Malformed
predicates.definition: Value satisfies / violates its declared semantic representation contract, e.g. a ten-digit identifier.

predicates.label: Canonical representation
predicates.definition: Representation equals / differs from the result of a specified normalization procedure.

predicates.label: Noncanonical representation
predicates.definition: Representation equals / differs from the result of a specified normalization procedure.

predicates.label: Decoding-valid
predicates.definition: Available source bytes can / cannot be decoded under a selected encoding. Correct decoding alone does not prove intended wording.

predicates.label: Decoding-invalid
predicates.definition: Available source bytes can / cannot be decoded under a selected encoding. Correct decoding alone does not prove intended wording.

predicates.label: Pattern match
predicates.definition: Value satisfies / fails a specified full-string or substring pattern; matching mode is explicit.

predicates.label: Pattern mismatch
predicates.definition: Value satisfies / fails a specified full-string or substring pattern; matching mode is explicit.

predicates.label: Expected length
predicates.definition: Length equals / differs from a specified length; character versus byte length is declared.

predicates.label: Unexpected length
predicates.definition: Length equals / differs from a specified length; character versus byte length is declared.

predicates.label: Length within bounds
predicates.definition: Length lies / does not lie inside the specified interval.

predicates.label: Length outside bounds
predicates.definition: Length lies / does not lie inside the specified interval.

predicates.label: Uniform length
predicates.definition: All values in a nonempty population have the same measured length / at least two lengths occur. This is a population property.

predicates.label: Varying length
predicates.definition: All values in a nonempty population have the same measured length / at least two lengths occur. This is a population property.

predicates.label: Checksum-valid
predicates.definition: An available checksum/check digit agrees / disagrees with the specified algorithm on an evaluable value.

predicates.label: Checksum-invalid
predicates.definition: An available checksum/check digit agrees / disagrees with the specified algorithm on an evaluable value.

predicates.label: Allowed characters
predicates.definition: All characters belong to a specified repertoire / at least one does not.

predicates.label: Disallowed characters present
predicates.definition: All characters belong to a specified repertoire / at least one does not.

predicates.label: Delimited structure valid
predicates.definition: Record text follows / violates declared delimiter, quoting and field-count rules.

predicates.label: Delimited structure invalid
predicates.definition: Record text follows / violates declared delimiter, quoting and field-count rules.

predicates.label: Alphabetic-only
predicates.definition: Nonempty string contains only letters under the chosen character rules / contains something else.

predicates.label: Not alphabetic-only
predicates.definition: Nonempty string contains only letters under the chosen character rules / contains something else.

predicates.label: Digit-only
predicates.definition: Nonempty string consists entirely of digits from the selected repertoire / does not. Signs and decimal separators are not digits.

predicates.label: Not digit-only
predicates.definition: Nonempty string consists entirely of digits from the selected repertoire / does not. Signs and decimal separators are not digits.

predicates.label: Alphanumeric-only
predicates.definition: Nonempty string contains only selected letters/digits / contains other characters.

predicates.label: Not alphanumeric-only
predicates.definition: Nonempty string contains only selected letters/digits / contains other characters.

predicates.label: ASCII-only
predicates.definition: Every character is in ASCII / at least one is not. “Unicode” is not the opposite of ASCII.

predicates.label: Contains non-ASCII
predicates.definition: Every character is in ASCII / at least one is not. “Unicode” is not the opposite of ASCII.

predicates.label: Mixed scripts
predicates.definition: Among strings with at least one script-bearing character, more than one script / exactly one script occurs under selected script rules.

predicates.label: Single script
predicates.definition: Among strings with at least one script-bearing character, more than one script / exactly one script occurs under selected script rules.

predicates.label: Has control characters
predicates.definition: At least one character belongs to the declared control-character set / none does.

predicates.label: No control characters
predicates.definition: At least one character belongs to the declared control-character set / none does.

predicates.label: Uppercase
predicates.definition: Among nonempty strings: all cased letters are upper; all are lower; both occur; no cased letters occur. Character/locale rules are explicit.

predicates.label: Lowercase
predicates.definition: Among nonempty strings: all cased letters are upper; all are lower; both occur; no cased letters occur. Character/locale rules are explicit.

predicates.label: Mixed case
predicates.definition: Among nonempty strings: all cased letters are upper; all are lower; both occur; no cased letters occur. Character/locale rules are explicit.

predicates.label: No cased letters
predicates.definition: Among nonempty strings: all cased letters are upper; all are lower; both occur; no cased letters occur. Character/locale rules are explicit.

predicates.label: Title-case conforming
predicates.definition: String follows / fails a chosen title-case convention. This is not assumed to be correct spelling for personal names.

predicates.label: Title-case nonconforming
predicates.definition: String follows / fails a chosen title-case convention. This is not assumed to be correct spelling for personal names.

predicates.label: Leading whitespace
predicates.definition: Selected whitespace occurs / does not occur at the start of a nonempty string.

predicates.label: No leading whitespace
predicates.definition: Selected whitespace occurs / does not occur at the start of a nonempty string.

predicates.label: Trailing whitespace
predicates.definition: Selected whitespace occurs / does not occur at the end of a nonempty string.

predicates.label: No trailing whitespace
predicates.definition: Selected whitespace occurs / does not occur at the end of a nonempty string.

predicates.label: Internal whitespace
predicates.definition: Selected whitespace occurs / does not occur between non-whitespace characters.

predicates.label: No internal whitespace
predicates.definition: Selected whitespace occurs / does not occur between non-whitespace characters.

predicates.label: Contains whitespace
predicates.definition: At least one selected whitespace character occurs / none occurs.

predicates.label: Whitespace-free
predicates.definition: At least one selected whitespace character occurs / none occurs.

predicates.label: Token present
predicates.definition: A specified token or keyword occurs / does not occur with declared token boundaries and case rules.

predicates.label: Token absent
predicates.definition: A specified token or keyword occurs / does not occur with declared token boundaries and case rules.

predicates.label: Prefix match
predicates.definition: String begins / does not begin with a specified sequence.

predicates.label: Prefix mismatch
predicates.definition: String begins / does not begin with a specified sequence.

predicates.label: Suffix match
predicates.definition: String ends / does not end with a specified sequence.

predicates.label: Suffix mismatch
predicates.definition: String ends / does not end with a specified sequence.

predicates.label: Substring present
predicates.definition: A specified character sequence occurs anywhere / does not occur, without requiring token boundaries.

predicates.label: Substring absent
predicates.definition: A specified character sequence occurs anywhere / does not occur, without requiring token boundaries.

predicates.label: Trimmed
predicates.definition: A nonempty string has neither leading nor trailing selected whitespace / has at least one. Composite of X09 and X10.

predicates.label: Untrimmed
predicates.definition: A nonempty string has neither leading nor trailing selected whitespace / has at least one. Composite of X09 and X10.

predicates.label: Negative
predicates.definition: A finite numeric value is below zero, equal to zero, or above zero.

predicates.label: Zero
predicates.definition: A finite numeric value is below zero, equal to zero, or above zero.

predicates.label: Positive
predicates.definition: A finite numeric value is below zero, equal to zero, or above zero.

predicates.label: Integral
predicates.definition: Finite value has no fractional component / has a fractional component. Decimal storage alone does not imply fractional content.

predicates.label: Fractional
predicates.definition: Finite value has no fractional component / has a fractional component. Decimal storage alone does not imply fractional content.

predicates.label: Even
predicates.definition: An integral value is divisible by two / is not.

predicates.label: Odd
predicates.definition: An integral value is divisible by two / is not.

predicates.label: Multiple of increment
predicates.definition: Value lies / does not lie on a declared numerical grid, with any tolerance specified.

predicates.label: Not a multiple of increment
predicates.definition: Value lies / does not lie on a declared numerical grid, with any tolerance specified.

predicates.label: Within precision/scale contract
predicates.definition: Value can / cannot be represented within a stated decimal precision/scale without disallowed change. Does not infer historical rounding.

predicates.label: Outside precision/scale contract
predicates.definition: Value can / cannot be represented within a stated decimal precision/scale without disallowed change. Does not infer historical rounding.

predicates.label: Finite
predicates.definition: Floating-point value is finite, an infinity, or not-a-number.

predicates.label: Infinite
predicates.definition: Floating-point value is finite, an infinity, or not-a-number.

predicates.label: NaN
predicates.definition: Floating-point value is finite, an infinity, or not-a-number.

predicates.label: Consistent with rounded source
predicates.definition: Target equals / differs from rounding an available source to declared precision. Does not prove the transformation actually occurred.

predicates.label: Inconsistent with rounded source
predicates.definition: Target equals / differs from rounding an available source to declared precision. Does not prove the transformation actually occurred.

predicates.label: Consistent with truncated source
predicates.definition: Target equals / differs from truncating an available source to declared precision.

predicates.label: Inconsistent with truncated source
predicates.definition: Target equals / differs from truncating an available source to declared precision.

predicates.label: Less than reference
predicates.definition: Value falls below, equals, or exceeds a specified comparable reference.

predicates.label: Equal to reference
predicates.definition: Value falls below, equals, or exceeds a specified comparable reference.

predicates.label: Greater than reference
predicates.definition: Value falls below, equals, or exceeds a specified comparable reference.

predicates.label: Within range
predicates.definition: Value lies / does not lie between selected bounds with explicit endpoint inclusion.

predicates.label: Outside range
predicates.definition: Value lies / does not lie between selected bounds with explicit endpoint inclusion.

predicates.label: Lower boundary
predicates.definition: For distinct bounds, value equals the lower bound, lies strictly between, equals the upper bound, or lies outside.

predicates.label: Interior
predicates.definition: For distinct bounds, value equals the lower bound, lies strictly between, equals the upper bound, or lies outside.

predicates.label: Upper boundary
predicates.definition: For distinct bounds, value equals the lower bound, lies strictly between, equals the upper bound, or lies outside.

predicates.label: Outside interval
predicates.definition: For distinct bounds, value equals the lower bound, lies strictly between, equals the upper bound, or lies outside.

predicates.label: At observed minimum
predicates.definition: Value equals / exceeds the minimum of its nonempty eligible population.

predicates.label: Above observed minimum
predicates.definition: Value equals / exceeds the minimum of its nonempty eligible population.

predicates.label: At observed maximum
predicates.definition: Value equals / is below the maximum of its nonempty eligible population.

predicates.label: Below observed maximum
predicates.definition: Value equals / is below the maximum of its nonempty eligible population.

predicates.label: Within tolerance
predicates.definition: Distance from a stated reference is at most / greater than the specified tolerance, using a defined distance measure.

predicates.label: Outside tolerance
predicates.definition: Distance from a stated reference is at most / greater than the specified tolerance, using a defined distance measure.

predicates.label: Valid calendar value
predicates.definition: Text/components represent / fail to represent a real date/time under the selected calendar and grammar. Not a search for impossible dates in an already valid native DATE column.

predicates.label: Invalid calendar value
predicates.definition: Text/components represent / fail to represent a real date/time under the selected calendar and grammar. Not a search for impossible dates in an already valid native DATE column.

predicates.label: Unambiguous interpretation
predicates.definition: Among values with at least one valid interpretation, the permitted formats/timezones produce one distinct meaning / more than one.

predicates.label: Ambiguous interpretation
predicates.definition: Among values with at least one valid interpretation, the permitted formats/timezones produce one distinct meaning / more than one.

predicates.label: Complete date/time specification
predicates.definition: All components required by the selected granularity are supplied / one or more are absent.

predicates.label: Partial date/time specification
predicates.definition: All components required by the selected granularity are supplied / one or more are absent.

predicates.label: Required granularity satisfied
predicates.definition: Interpreted value obeys / fails the declared granularity, e.g. date-only values contain no non-midnight time component.

predicates.label: Required granularity violated
predicates.definition: Interpreted value obeys / fails the declared granularity, e.g. date-only values contain no non-midnight time component.

predicates.label: Timezone specified
predicates.definition: Representation or accompanying metadata supplies / does not supply the timezone needed for interpretation.

predicates.label: Timezone unspecified
predicates.definition: Representation or accompanying metadata supplies / does not supply the timezone needed for interpretation.

predicates.label: Before cutoff
predicates.definition: Interpreted value precedes, equals, or follows a fixed cutoff. Past/present/future are aliases when the reference instant is “now”; a present-day window instead uses T03.

predicates.label: At cutoff
predicates.definition: Interpreted value precedes, equals, or follows a fixed cutoff. Past/present/future are aliases when the reference instant is “now”; a present-day window instead uses T03.

predicates.label: After cutoff
predicates.definition: Interpreted value precedes, equals, or follows a fixed cutoff. Past/present/future are aliases when the reference instant is “now”; a present-day window instead uses T03.

predicates.label: On or before cutoff
predicates.definition: Value is at most / greater than a fixed cutoff. Retained as a convenient pair, distinct from strict Before.

predicates.label: After cutoff
predicates.definition: Value is at most / greater than a fixed cutoff. Retained as a convenient pair, distinct from strict Before.

predicates.label: Within period
predicates.definition: Value belongs / does not belong to a declared calendar/time interval.

predicates.label: Outside period
predicates.definition: Value belongs / does not belong to a declared calendar/time interval.

predicates.label: Selected calendar class
predicates.definition: Value belongs / does not belong to a chosen weekday, month, fiscal period or business-calendar class.

predicates.label: Other calendar class
predicates.definition: Value belongs / does not belong to a chosen weekday, month, fiscal period or business-calendar class.

predicates.label: Fresh
predicates.definition: A non-future record age is at most / greater than a declared freshness limit relative to a fixed evaluation instant. Future-dated rows use T01.

predicates.label: Stale
predicates.definition: A non-future record age is at most / greater than a declared freshness limit relative to a fixed evaluation instant. Future-dated rows use T01.

predicates.label: On-time
predicates.definition: Recorded event time is at most / greater than its applicable deadline. Missing events use P02 or E03; they are not automatically late completed events.

predicates.label: Late
predicates.definition: Recorded event time is at most / greater than its applicable deadline. Missing events use P02 or E03; they are not automatically late completed events.

predicates.label: Within latency allowance
predicates.definition: A nonnegative observed delay between specified events meets / exceeds the allowed duration. Reversed event order uses E01.

predicates.label: Exceeds latency allowance
predicates.definition: A nonnegative observed delay between specified events meets / exceeds the allowed duration. Reversed event order uses E01.

predicates.label: Ordered endpoints
predicates.definition: Start is at or before end / start is after end, for a pair with both endpoints supplied.

predicates.label: Reversed endpoints
predicates.definition: Start is at or before end / start is after end, for a pair with both endpoints supplied.

predicates.label: Expired
predicates.definition: For a valid period and as-of instant: instant is at/after end, within [start,end), or before start. Declared open endpoints may represent infinities.

predicates.label: Effective
predicates.definition: For a valid period and as-of instant: instant is at/after end, within [start,end), or before start. Declared open endpoints may represent infinities.

predicates.label: Not yet effective
predicates.definition: For a valid period and as-of instant: instant is at/after end, within [start,end), or before start. Declared open endpoints may represent infinities.

predicates.label: Required event present
predicates.definition: A required matching event exists / does not exist for the subject in the chosen observation window.

predicates.label: Required event absent
predicates.definition: A required matching event exists / does not exist for the subject in the chosen observation window.

predicates.label: Overlapping intervals
predicates.definition: Two valid intervals share eligible time / do not; boundary-touch policy is declared.

predicates.label: Nonoverlapping intervals
predicates.definition: Two valid intervals share eligible time / do not; boundary-touch policy is declared.

predicates.label: Contiguous succession
predicates.definition: Consecutive valid intervals meet at the selected boundary / have a gap or overlap.

predicates.label: Noncontiguous succession
predicates.definition: Consecutive valid intervals meet at the selected boundary / have a gap or overlap.

predicates.label: Expected next step
predicates.definition: A row with a predecessor advances by the required sequence increment / does not. First rows are outside this population.

predicates.label: Unexpected next step
predicates.definition: A row with a predecessor advances by the required sequence increment / does not. First rows are outside this population.

predicates.label: Nondecreasing sequence
predicates.definition: A row with a predecessor is at least as large as that predecessor / is smaller, under the declared order.

predicates.label: Sequence regression
predicates.definition: A row with a predecessor is at least as large as that predecessor / is smaller, under the declared order.

predicates.label: Permitted transition
predicates.definition: A known ordered state pair is / is not in the allowed transition relation.

predicates.label: Forbidden transition
predicates.definition: A known ordered state pair is / is not in the allowed transition relation.

predicates.label: First occurrence
predicates.definition: Row is the earliest for an entity under a declared total order / has a predecessor.

predicates.label: Later occurrence
predicates.definition: Row is the earliest for an entity under a declared total order / has a predecessor.

predicates.label: Latest occurrence
predicates.definition: Row is the latest for an entity under a declared total order / has a successor.

predicates.label: Earlier occurrence
predicates.definition: Row is the latest for an entity under a declared total order / has a successor.

predicates.label: Increasing
predicates.definition: Value is greater than, equal to, or smaller than its predecessor under a declared ordering. First rows are excluded.

predicates.label: Unchanged
predicates.definition: Value is greater than, equal to, or smaller than its predecessor under a declared ordering. First rows are excluded.

predicates.label: Decreasing
predicates.definition: Value is greater than, equal to, or smaller than its predecessor under a declared ordering. First rows are excluded.

predicates.label: In reference set
predicates.definition: Non-null source value or tuple has / lacks a matching key in a designated reference population.

predicates.label: Outside reference set
predicates.definition: Non-null source value or tuple has / lacks a matching key in a designated reference population.

predicates.label: Referenced
predicates.definition: A reference-side key is used / unused by the designated source population. Includes Has child / No child for a declared parent-child relation.

predicates.label: Unreferenced
predicates.definition: A reference-side key is used / unused by the designated source population. Includes Has child / No child for a declared parent-child relation.

predicates.label: Parent exists
predicates.definition: A non-null child parent-key has / lacks a matching parent. Role-specific form of K01; a legitimate root without a parent key is not automatically orphaned.

predicates.label: Orphan reference
predicates.definition: A non-null child parent-key has / lacks a matching parent. Role-specific form of K01; a legitimate root without a parent key is not automatically orphaned.

predicates.label: Zero matches
predicates.definition: A source row matches zero, exactly one, or more than one reference record under a declared join condition.

predicates.label: One match
predicates.definition: A source row matches zero, exactly one, or more than one reference record under a declared join condition.

predicates.label: Multiple matches
predicates.definition: A source row matches zero, exactly one, or more than one reference record under a declared join condition.

predicates.label: Effective reference
predicates.definition: Among matched reference records with known validity periods, the reference is / is not effective at the subject's relevant date.

predicates.label: Ineffective reference
predicates.definition: Among matched reference records with known validity periods, the reference is / is not effective at the subject's relevant date.

predicates.label: Approved reference
predicates.definition: Matched reference carries approved, deprecated or another known lifecycle status under disjoint specified sets. An unmatched key is K01, not Deprecated.

predicates.label: Deprecated reference
predicates.definition: Matched reference carries approved, deprecated or another known lifecycle status under disjoint specified sets. An unmatched key is K01, not Deprecated.

predicates.label: Other reference status
predicates.definition: Matched reference carries approved, deprecated or another known lifecycle status under disjoint specified sets. An unmatched key is K01, not Deprecated.

predicates.label: Mapping available
predicates.definition: A declared translation/crosswalk supplies / does not supply at least one mapping for a source value. Mapping ambiguity is K04.

predicates.label: Mapping unavailable
predicates.definition: A declared translation/crosswalk supplies / does not supply at least one mapping for a source value. Mapping ambiguity is K04.

predicates.label: One-to-one
predicates.definition: On deduplicated observed entity-pairs with at least one edge: classify by whether every left entity has at most one right and every right at most one left; both, left only unrestricted, right only unrestricted, or both unrestricted. More precisely: 1:1 both maxima=1; 1:M left max>1/right max=1; M:1 left max=1/right max>1; M:M both maxima>1. Orientation and population are fixed.

predicates.label: One-to-many
predicates.definition: On deduplicated observed entity-pairs with at least one edge: classify by whether every left entity has at most one right and every right at most one left; both, left only unrestricted, right only unrestricted, or both unrestricted. More precisely: 1:1 both maxima=1; 1:M left max>1/right max=1; M:1 left max=1/right max>1; M:M both maxima>1. Orientation and population are fixed.

predicates.label: Many-to-one
predicates.definition: On deduplicated observed entity-pairs with at least one edge: classify by whether every left entity has at most one right and every right at most one left; both, left only unrestricted, right only unrestricted, or both unrestricted. More precisely: 1:1 both maxima=1; 1:M left max>1/right max=1; M:1 left max=1/right max>1; M:M both maxima>1. Orientation and population are fixed.

predicates.label: Many-to-many
predicates.definition: On deduplicated observed entity-pairs with at least one edge: classify by whether every left entity has at most one right and every right at most one left; both, left only unrestricted, right only unrestricted, or both unrestricted. More precisely: 1:1 both maxima=1; 1:M left max>1/right max=1; M:1 left max=1/right max>1; M:M both maxima>1. Orientation and population are fixed.

predicates.label: Functionally dependent
predicates.definition: For a nonempty determinant group X, all eligible rows have one Y value / multiple Y values. Testing all groups supports an observed X→Y claim.

predicates.label: Functional-dependency violation
predicates.definition: For a nonempty determinant group X, all eligible rows have one Y value / multiple Y values. Testing all groups supports an observed X→Y claim.

predicates.label: One related entity
predicates.definition: A subject with at least one relationship has one distinct target / more than one. Zero-related subjects are K04.

predicates.label: Multiple related entities
predicates.definition: A subject with at least one relationship has one distinct target / more than one. Zero-related subjects are K04.

predicates.label: Required relationship coverage
predicates.definition: Every eligible subject has the required relation / at least one does not.

predicates.label: Incomplete relationship coverage
predicates.definition: Every eligible subject has the required relation / at least one does not.

predicates.label: Join multiplicity within allowance
predicates.definition: Number of output matches per source row is at most / greater than the declared allowance. Counts matching records, unlike L03's distinct entities.

predicates.label: Join multiplicity exceeds allowance
predicates.definition: Number of output matches per source row is at most / greater than the declared allowance. Counts matching records, unlike L03's distinct entities.

predicates.label: Values agree
predicates.definition: Two evaluable fields agree / disagree under a declared equality, normalization or tolerance rule.

predicates.label: Values disagree
predicates.definition: Two evaluable fields agree / disagree under a declared equality, normalization or tolerance rule.

predicates.label: Column order respected
predicates.definition: Selected A is at most B / exceeds B; may compare amounts, ranks or dates.

predicates.label: Column order violated
predicates.definition: Selected A is at most B / exceeds B; may compare amounts, ranks or dates.

predicates.label: Derivation consistent
predicates.definition: Stored result agrees / disagrees with the declared calculation from available inputs within any specified tolerance.

predicates.label: Derivation inconsistent
predicates.definition: Stored result agrees / disagrees with the declared calculation from available inputs within any specified tolerance.

predicates.label: Aggregate reconciled
predicates.definition: A defined sum/count/other aggregate agrees / disagrees with an available control value.

predicates.label: Aggregate unreconciled
predicates.definition: A defined sum/count/other aggregate agrees / disagrees with an available control value.

predicates.label: Allowed combination
predicates.definition: Evaluable tuple is / is not in the allowed cross-field relationship, e.g. country–province or currency–account type.

predicates.label: Forbidden combination
predicates.definition: Evaluable tuple is / is not in the allowed cross-field relationship, e.g. country–province or currency–account type.

predicates.label: Group consistent
predicates.definition: Rows for the same declared entity agree / disagree on a selected attribute at a fixed relevant scope/time.

predicates.label: Group conflicting
predicates.definition: Rows for the same declared entity agree / disagree on a selected attribute at a fixed relevant scope/time.

predicates.label: Units compatible
predicates.definition: Known units or currency designations can / cannot be compared under the selected dimensional/conversion policy.

predicates.label: Units incompatible
predicates.definition: Known units or currency designations can / cannot be compared under the selected dimensional/conversion policy.

predicates.label: Classified
predicates.definition: Subject has at least one accepted assignment / has none in the specified scheme.

predicates.label: Unclassified
predicates.definition: Subject has at least one accepted assignment / has none in the specified scheme.

predicates.label: Single-classified
predicates.definition: Among classified subjects, exactly one distinct accepted class / more than one is assigned. Multiple classes may be legitimate.

predicates.label: Multi-classified
predicates.definition: Among classified subjects, exactly one distinct accepted class / more than one is assigned. Multiple classes may be legitimate.

predicates.label: Unambiguous classification
predicates.definition: Candidate evidence resolves to exactly one admissible class / multiple competing classes when the scheme requires one. Zero candidates are unresolved, not ambiguous.

predicates.label: Ambiguous classification
predicates.definition: Candidate evidence resolves to exactly one admissible class / multiple competing classes when the scheme requires one. Zero candidates are unresolved, not ambiguous.

predicates.label: Classification consistent
predicates.definition: Recorded classification agrees / disagrees with an available authoritative assignment or deterministic rule.

predicates.label: Classification inconsistent
predicates.definition: Recorded classification agrees / disagrees with an available authoritative assignment or deterministic rule.

predicates.label: In selected category
predicates.definition: Subject belongs / does not belong to a selected category in a defined scheme. A semantic specialization of M02.

predicates.label: Outside selected category
predicates.definition: Subject belongs / does not belong to a selected category in a defined scheme. A semantic specialization of M02.

predicates.label: Rule compliant
predicates.definition: An evaluable, explicitly named business rule holds / fails. Generic extension point, not an unqualified global label of validity.

predicates.label: Rule violation
predicates.definition: An evaluable, explicitly named business rule holds / fails. Generic extension point, not an unqualified global label of validity.

predicates.label: Active
predicates.definition: Subject is / is not active under a defined lifecycle rule at a fixed as-of point. Unknown lifecycle data is indeterminate.

predicates.label: Inactive
predicates.definition: Subject is / is not active under a defined lifecycle rule at a fixed as-of point. Unknown lifecycle data is indeterminate.

predicates.label: Eligible
predicates.definition: Available facts satisfy / fail a declared eligibility rule.

predicates.label: Ineligible
predicates.definition: Available facts satisfy / fail a declared eligibility rule.

predicates.label: Authorized
predicates.definition: An action/subject is permitted / prohibited by the applicable explicit authorization relation. Missing policy evidence is indeterminate.

predicates.label: Unauthorized
predicates.definition: An action/subject is permitted / prohibited by the applicable explicit authorization relation. Missing policy evidence is indeterminate.

predicates.label: Current version
predicates.definition: In a complete declared version chain, record is the selected current revision / an earlier superseded revision. Scheduled future revisions are outside this pair.

predicates.label: Superseded version
predicates.definition: In a complete declared version chain, record is the selected current revision / an earlier superseded revision. Scheduled future revisions are outside this pair.

predicates.label: Deleted-marked
predicates.definition: Available soft-deletion marker indicates deletion / does not. This does not inspect physically removed rows.

predicates.label: Not deleted-marked
predicates.definition: Available soft-deletion marker indicates deletion / does not. This does not inspect physically removed rows.

predicates.label: Coordinates in domain
predicates.definition: Coordinates meet / fail the legal numeric bounds of the declared reference system.

predicates.label: Coordinates outside domain
predicates.definition: Coordinates meet / fail the legal numeric bounds of the declared reference system.

predicates.label: Geography known
predicates.definition: Value or combination has / lacks a matching record in a selected geographic reference release.

predicates.label: Geography unknown to reference
predicates.definition: Value or combination has / lacks a matching record in a selected geographic reference release.

predicates.label: Spatially resolvable
predicates.definition: Available mappings resolve a subject to at least one usable spatial representation / none. Uniqueness of mapping is separate.

predicates.label: Spatially unresolved
predicates.definition: Available mappings resolve a subject to at least one usable spatial representation / none. Uniqueness of mapping is separate.

predicates.label: Inside selected area
predicates.definition: A resolved point/geometry satisfies / fails the selected spatial containment relation; treatment of boundaries and partial overlap is explicit.

predicates.label: Outside selected area
predicates.definition: A resolved point/geometry satisfies / fails the selected spatial containment relation; treatment of boundaries and partial overlap is explicit.

predicates.label: Domestic
predicates.definition: Known geography belongs / does not belong to the declared home jurisdiction.

predicates.label: Foreign
predicates.definition: Known geography belongs / does not belong to the declared home jurisdiction.

predicates.label: Selected settlement class
predicates.definition: Known classification is / is not the selected urban/rural/etc. class under an identified scheme. No universal binary urban/rural assumption.

predicates.label: Other settlement class
predicates.definition: Known classification is / is not the selected urban/rural/etc. class under an identified scheme. No universal binary urban/rural assumption.

predicates.label: Geometry valid
predicates.definition: Geometry satisfies / fails the spatial representation's specified validity rules.

predicates.label: Geometry invalid
predicates.definition: Geometry satisfies / fails the spatial representation's specified validity rules.

predicates.label: Boundary release applicable
predicates.definition: Known boundary version is / is not applicable to the relevant date and use.

predicates.label: Boundary release inapplicable
predicates.definition: Known boundary version is / is not applicable to the relevant date and use.

predicates.label: Frequent
predicates.definition: Observed value frequency is at least / below a declared count/share threshold. “Common” and “rare” are aliases.

predicates.label: Infrequent
predicates.definition: Observed value frequency is at least / below a declared count/share threshold. “Common” and “rare” are aliases.

predicates.label: Modal
predicates.definition: Observed category has / does not have the maximum frequency; all tied modes qualify.

predicates.label: Nonmodal
predicates.definition: Observed category has / does not have the maximum frequency; all tied modes qualify.

predicates.label: Inlier
predicates.definition: Value falls within / outside a declared statistical rule in its reference population. “Typical” is an alias for Inlier only under that rule.

predicates.label: Outlier
predicates.definition: Value falls within / outside a declared statistical rule in its reference population. “Typical” is an alias for Inlier only under that rule.

predicates.label: Dispersion within bounds
predicates.definition: A specified defined dispersion statistic lies / does not lie in its interval. Statistic and minimum sample requirements must be named.

predicates.label: Dispersion outside bounds
predicates.definition: A specified defined dispersion statistic lies / does not lie in its interval. Statistic and minimum sample requirements must be named.

predicates.label: Distribution compatible
predicates.definition: A declared comparison of an observed distribution to a baseline meets / fails its criterion. Compatibility does not prove identical distributions.

predicates.label: Distribution incompatible
predicates.definition: A declared comparison of an observed distribution to a baseline meets / fails its criterion. Compatibility does not prove identical distributions.

predicates.label: Drift within allowance
predicates.definition: A declared difference in a metric/distribution across matched populations or periods is at most / above its limit.

predicates.label: Drift exceeds allowance
predicates.definition: A declared difference in a metric/distribution across matched populations or periods is at most / above its limit.

predicates.label: Entropy within bounds
predicates.definition: Entropy under declared categories/bins and log base lies / does not lie in its chosen interval.

predicates.label: Entropy outside bounds
predicates.definition: Entropy under declared categories/bins and log base lies / does not lie in its chosen interval.

predicates.label: Association meets criterion
predicates.definition: A specified association statistic between variables meets / fails a threshold on an adequate sample. Does not establish causality or predictive performance.

predicates.label: Association below criterion
predicates.definition: A specified association statistic between variables meets / fails a threshold on an adequate sample. Does not establish causality or predictive performance.

predicates.label: Empty population
predicates.definition: Selected table/group contains zero / more than zero rows.

predicates.label: Nonempty population
predicates.definition: Selected table/group contains zero / more than zero rows.

predicates.label: Volume within bounds
predicates.definition: Row count lies / does not lie within a declared interval.

predicates.label: Volume outside bounds
predicates.definition: Row count lies / does not lie within a declared interval.

predicates.label: Expected member observed
predicates.definition: Member of an enumerated expected domain occurs / does not occur in the observed population. Selects expected-domain members, including those with no fact row.

predicates.label: Expected member absent
predicates.definition: Member of an enumerated expected domain occurs / does not occur in the observed population. Selects expected-domain members, including those with no fact row.

predicates.label: Domain fully covered
predicates.definition: Every expected domain member is observed / at least one is absent.

predicates.label: Domain incompletely covered
predicates.definition: Every expected domain member is observed / at least one is absent.

predicates.label: Underrepresented
predicates.definition: Category's observed share is below, inside, or above a declared interval around an external/declared baseline. No claim of sampling representativeness follows automatically.

predicates.label: Within representation bounds
predicates.definition: Category's observed share is below, inside, or above a declared interval around an external/declared baseline. No claim of sampling representativeness follows automatically.

predicates.label: Overrepresented
predicates.definition: Category's observed share is below, inside, or above a declared interval around an external/declared baseline. No claim of sampling representativeness follows automatically.

predicates.label: Balanced
predicates.definition: Specified category proportions meet / fail an explicit balance criterion. Balance need not mean equal shares.

predicates.label: Unbalanced
predicates.definition: Specified category proportions meet / fail an explicit balance criterion. Balance need not mean equal shares.

predicates.label: Shared key
predicates.definition: A key in the union of compared extracts occurs in both, source only, or target only. Align population filters and extraction times.

predicates.label: Source-only key
predicates.definition: A key in the union of compared extracts occurs in both, source only, or target only. Align population filters and extraction times.

predicates.label: Target-only key
predicates.definition: A key in the union of compared extracts occurs in both, source only, or target only. Align population filters and extraction times.

predicates.label: Unchanged record
predicates.definition: Among unambiguously matched keys, selected attributes agree / disagree across extracts.

predicates.label: Changed record
predicates.definition: Among unambiguously matched keys, selected attributes agree / disagree across extracts.

predicates.label: Reconciled measure
predicates.definition: A chosen count, total or statistic agrees / disagrees across aligned extracts within tolerance.

predicates.label: Unreconciled measure
predicates.definition: A chosen count, total or statistic agrees / disagrees across aligned extracts within tolerance.

predicates.label: Multiplicity preserved
predicates.definition: Occurrence count of a compared key or record projection agrees / differs between extracts.

predicates.label: Multiplicity changed
predicates.definition: Occurrence count of a compared key or record projection agrees / differs between extracts.

predicates.label: New domain value
predicates.definition: A current value is absent / present in the chosen historical reference population.

predicates.label: Previously observed domain value
predicates.definition: A current value is absent / present in the chosen historical reference population.

predicates.label: Root
predicates.definition: Node has no declared parent assignment / at least one; missing referenced parents remain K03.

predicates.label: Non-root
predicates.definition: Node has no declared parent assignment / at least one; missing referenced parents remain K03.

predicates.label: Leaf
predicates.definition: Node has no observed children / at least one.

predicates.label: Non-leaf
predicates.definition: Node has no observed children / at least one.

predicates.label: Connected
predicates.definition: Node has at least one incident edge / none in the specified graph; declares whether self-loops count.

predicates.label: Isolated
predicates.definition: Node has at least one incident edge / none in the specified graph; declares whether self-loops count.

predicates.label: On a cycle
predicates.definition: Node participates / does not participate in a cycle under the declared directed/undirected graph definition.

predicates.label: Not on a cycle
predicates.definition: Node participates / does not participate in a cycle under the declared directed/undirected graph definition.

predicates.label: Reachable
predicates.definition: Node has / lacks an allowed path from a specified source/root set in the available graph.

predicates.label: Unreachable
predicates.definition: Node has / lacks an allowed path from a specified source/root set in the available graph.

predicates.label: Self-reference
predicates.definition: A non-null referenced node identifier equals / differs from the subject's own identifier.

predicates.label: No self-reference
predicates.definition: A non-null referenced node identifier equals / differs from the subject's own identifier.

predicates.label: Depth within bounds
predicates.definition: Defined node depth lies / does not lie inside a chosen interval. Root set, path convention and cycle treatment must be specified.

predicates.label: Depth outside bounds
predicates.definition: Defined node depth lies / does not lie inside a chosen interval. Root set, path convention and cycle treatment must be specified.

predicates.label: Document syntax valid
predicates.definition: Payload parses / fails to parse under the selected JSON/XML/other syntax. Native validated storage may make the negative member unreachable.

predicates.label: Document syntax invalid
predicates.definition: Payload parses / fails to parse under the selected JSON/XML/other syntax. Native validated storage may make the negative member unreachable.

predicates.label: Path present
predicates.definition: A selected path exists / does not exist in a parsed document. A present JSON null is not an absent path.

predicates.label: Path absent
predicates.definition: A selected path exists / does not exist in a parsed document. A present JSON null is not an absent path.

predicates.label: Expected node type
predicates.definition: Existing node has / lacks the expected scalar/object/array/etc. type.

predicates.label: Unexpected node type
predicates.definition: Existing node has / lacks the expected scalar/object/array/etc. type.

predicates.label: Document contract conforming
predicates.definition: Parsed document meets / fails declared required paths, types and other structural constraints.

predicates.label: Document contract nonconforming
predicates.definition: Parsed document meets / fails declared required paths, types and other structural constraints.

predicates.label: Collection size within bounds
predicates.definition: Parsed array/collection member count lies / does not lie in a specified interval.

predicates.label: Collection size outside bounds
predicates.definition: Parsed array/collection member count lies / does not lie in a specified interval.

predicates.label: JSON null
predicates.definition: An existing parsed JSON node is the JSON null literal / another value.

predicates.label: Non-null JSON node
predicates.definition: An existing parsed JSON node is the JSON null literal / another value.

predicates.label: Verification recorded
predicates.definition: Qualifying verification evidence is / is not attached to a data subject for a named rule and scope. This says nothing about whether verification passed.

predicates.label: No verification recorded
predicates.definition: Qualifying verification evidence is / is not attached to a data subject for a named rule and scope. This says nothing about whether verification passed.

predicates.label: Approved provenance
predicates.definition: Known source belongs / does not belong to a declared approved-source set. Unknown source is handled by P02.

predicates.label: Unapproved provenance
predicates.definition: Known source belongs / does not belong to a declared approved-source set. Unknown source is handled by P02.

predicates.label: Evidence agrees
predicates.definition: Available independent records agree / disagree on the specified assertion under a defined reconciliation rule.

predicates.label: Evidence conflicts
predicates.definition: Available independent records agree / disagree on the specified assertion under a defined reconciliation rule.

predicates.label: Expected object present
predicates.definition: Expected table/column/constraint exists / does not exist in the imported metadata inventory.

predicates.label: Expected object absent
predicates.definition: Expected table/column/constraint exists / does not exist in the imported metadata inventory.

predicates.label: Declared type matches
predicates.definition: Imported datatype agrees / disagrees with the selected expected type. Separate from V02's content conversion.

predicates.label: Declared type differs
predicates.definition: Imported datatype agrees / disagrees with the selected expected type. Separate from V02's content conversion.

predicates.label: Declared nullability matches
predicates.definition: Imported nullability agrees / disagrees with the expected declaration.

predicates.label: Declared nullability differs
predicates.definition: Imported nullability agrees / disagrees with the expected declaration.

predicates.label: Required constraint declared
predicates.definition: Required key/reference/check constraint appears / does not appear in supplied metadata. Declaration does not prove enablement or historical validation.

predicates.label: Required constraint undeclared
predicates.definition: Required key/reference/check constraint appears / does not appear in supplied metadata. Declaration does not prove enablement or historical validation.

predicates.label: Constraint enabled
predicates.definition: A known constraint's imported enablement status is enabled / disabled. Missing status is indeterminate.

predicates.label: Constraint disabled
predicates.definition: A known constraint's imported enablement status is enabled / disabled. Missing status is indeterminate.

predicates.label: Constraint validated
predicates.definition: A known constraint's imported validation status indicates validation / nonvalidation.

predicates.label: Constraint not validated
predicates.definition: A known constraint's imported validation status indicates validation / nonvalidation.

predicates.label: Structure unchanged
predicates.definition: Selected metadata properties agree / disagree between aligned schema snapshots.

predicates.label: Structure changed
predicates.definition: Selected metadata properties agree / disagree between aligned schema snapshots.

predicates.label: All component predicates hold
predicates.definition: On a common population with determinate components, every selected predicate is true / at least one is false.

predicates.label: At least one fails
predicates.definition: On a common population with determinate components, every selected predicate is true / at least one is false.

predicates.label: At least one component holds
predicates.definition: At least one selected predicate is true / all are false.

predicates.label: None holds
predicates.definition: At least one selected predicate is true / all are false.

predicates.label: Exactly one component holds
predicates.definition: Exactly one selected predicate is true / zero or more than one are true.

predicates.label: Not exactly one holds
predicates.definition: Exactly one selected predicate is true / zero or more than one are true.

predicates.label: Conditional rule satisfied
predicates.definition: Among subjects where condition P is true, Q is true / false. Subjects where P is false are outside this investigation's population.

predicates.label: Conditional rule violated
predicates.definition: Among subjects where condition P is true, Q is true / false. Subjects where P is false are outside this investigation's population.
